items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: So I went on by Louis back there. Back then, I found Louis. I said, Louis, you gonna play in the brass band tomorrow? He said, oh, man, you know I can't make that... Louis took a big jumbo bottle and drank it down... Had to lay Louis out.

ctx.x: Bill Matthews, you can start anytime you wish and tell us a little bit about your life, when you were born, where and so on.

Bill Matthews, as old man Bill Matthews speaking, one of the New Orleans original who has been playing jazz for over 40 years, is still going strong, 1959. Born of New Orleans original drummers, 1915 to 1919, it was Alphonse P. Q. Suggestions, you were a young man Billy, my boy, why don't you learn some other instrument. So I've taken P. Q. advice, my choice was trombone. But before I quit playing drums, I was playing with some of the New Orleans best jazz bands. 1915, Buddy Petit, one of New Orleans jazz trumpet…
Did you work at the Lyric Theater with him or in the dance band? Did you work in the theater with him or with Robichaud?
